mechanism_narrative: The sustained and accelerating decline in retail and recreation mobility over the past four weeks indicates a strong negative momentum that will continue to drive RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days, indicating a reversal of the recent trend.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp and sustained decline in WORKPLACES mobility, falling below a critical threshold, reflects severe restrictions on non-essential work, which will directly reduce RETAIL_REC as people stay home.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES remaining below -40% for the period.

mechanism_narrative: The combined effect of significantly increased RESIDENTIAL mobility and sharply decreased TRANSIT usage indicates a widespread stay-at-home behavior, which will suppress non-essential retail and recreation activity.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC shows an upward trend over the next 28 days while RESIDENTIAL remains high and TRANSIT remains low.

mechanism_narrative: The current mobility snapshot, characterized by steep declines in RETAIL_REC and WORKPLACES, is indicative of a severe lockdown regime, which will continue to depress retail and recreation activity for the foreseeable future.
failure_condition: The mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than the mean of the last 28 days, suggesting an easing of the lockdown impact.

mechanism_narrative: A significant week-on-week drop in RETAIL_REC, exceeding 10 percentage points, signals an immediate and sharp contraction in consumer activity that will persist over the very short term.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases in the week immediately following the observed drop, invalidating the short-term momentum.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS mobility significantly increases while RESIDENTIAL mobility also rises, it indicates people are seeking local outdoor recreation due to stay-at-home orders, diverting activity from traditional retail and recreation venues.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above 50% AND RESIDENTIAL rises above 4%
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next two weeks despite high PARKS and RESIDENTIAL mobility, suggesting a different pattern of local activity.

mechanism_narrative: A substantial decline in GROCERY_PHARM mobility, falling below -25%, indicates a broader reduction in essential outings and overall public movement, which will inevitably drag down non-essential RETAIL_REC.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days while GROCERY_PHARM remains significantly depressed, indicating a decoupling of essential and non-essential activity.

mechanism_narrative: The severe and accelerating decline in TRANSIT station visits, falling below -45%, signifies a drastic reduction in commuting and general public transport usage, directly limiting access to and participation in retail and recreation.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC shows an increase over the next two weeks despite TRANSIT remaining below -45%, suggesting alternative transport or local activity patterns.
